python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df = pd.read_csv('/Users/bobscott/Documents/github/localAI/bench/dabench-hard/data/auto-mpg.csv')

# Coerce to numeric (handles non-numeric placeholders)
df['horsepower'] = pd.to_numeric(df['horsepower'], errors='coerce')

# Check for missing values after coercion
print('Missing after coercion:', df['horsepower'].isna().sum())

# Impute missing values with mean
mean_hp = df['horsepower'].mean()
print('Mean horsepower:', mean_hp)
df['horsepower'] = df['horsepower'].fillna(mean_hp)

# Log transformation (natural log, base e)
df['horsepower_log'] = np.log(df['horsepower'])

# Calculate mean and std of transformed column
mean_transformed = df['horsepower_log'].mean()
std_transformed = df['horsepower_log'].std()

print('Mean transformed:', round(mean_transformed, 2))
print('Std transformed:', round(std_transformed, 2))
"
